verdict.rationale: Bento is an email marketing platform, so A/B testing subject lines or content is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions A/B or split testing, content variants, or automatic winner selection from engagement. Workflow branching and broadcast creation are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can A/B test subject lines or content variants and have the winner picked from real engagement
